text:
Maya Tran: Quick flag — pulled post-launch numbers for the May launch, and there's a weird flattening in conversion after day 7. dashboard shows flat DAU->MQL at ~1.2% from day 8 onward :thinking_face:
Evan Cole: ugh, saw a similar blip in the weekly report. do you think it's attribution windowing or actual funnel change? :eyes:
Maya Tran: haven't ruled either out. default pulseboard cohort window is 7 days, but our lead routing has a 14-day lookback for some channels. could be double-counting or dropoff in paid channels
Jorge Rivas: can you paste the SQL you used? i'll run a join against leadflow to see if UTM mapping changed
Maya Tran: here's the core snippet i ran: ```SELECT cohort_day, count(distinct user_id) as mqls FROM events WHERE event='mql' AND launch_id='may_release' GROUP BY cohort_day ORDER BY cohort_day;```
Leah Park: FYI i deployed a routing tweak last week that backfills to HubSpot using `utm_content` instead of `utm_campaign` for some paid partners — that could change attribution grouping
Tom B: that routing tweak would definitely reshuffle cohorts. does pulseboard use the new hubspot mapping or old raw events?
Maya Tran: pulseboard's feed is raw events with `utm_campaign` parsing. hubspot backfill could make dashboards and CRM show different trends
ops-bot: Automated job complete: leadflow-sync to crm-backfill finished at 2026-03-22T09:23:12Z. 7.2k records processed.
Evan Cole: ok two parallel hypotheses: 1) real drop in conversion for organic channels starting day 8, 2) attribution mapping changes making it look flat. we should validate by isolating purely organic UTM-less cohort
Jorge Rivas: running a quick diff now. i'll produce two series: raw-event-based cohort vs crm-backfilled cohort. should have results in 20 mins
Leah Park: also check webinar registrants routing. a few registrants came in via a redirect that strips query params, so registration source might be 'direct' instead of 'email_campaign'
Maya Tran: good call. that would move some high-intent leads into the wrong bucket and depress conversion visible on the dashboard
Tom B: can we add a small annotation layer to pulseboard that flags any recent routing/backfill changes? would help avoid false alarms next time
Evan Cole: +1. even a simple note on dashboard metadata saying "last routing change" with timestamp would help
Jorge Rivas: diff done: raw-event cohort shows drop at day 8, crm-backfilled cohort keeps a small uptick. delta concentrated in paid/social channels where hubspot backfill reassigned source to partner X
Maya Tran: that's telling — looks attribution mapping caused the flatten. but need to confirm whether the actual users converted later or just got re-labeled
Leah Park: i can pull session-level traces for a sample of the impacted user_ids and see if they had conversion events after day 7
ops-bot: Quick note: scheduled "post-launch signal sanity" meeting at 2026-03-22T10:10:00Z for 30m. participants added: Maya Tran, Jorge Rivas, Evan Cole, Leah Park
Maya Tran: thanks. action items: Jorge to update diff chart and export CSV, Leah to pull session traces for 200 impacted users, Evan to add dashboard annotation and a short blurb for PMs, Tom to scope a pulseboard metadata field (low effort)
Tom B: can do the metadata field today. will also add a toggle to show raw vs crm-backfilled series
Evan Cole: i'll draft the PM note, 2 bullets + link to CSV
Jorge Rivas: uploading CSV to #marketing-assets now — link: https://redwood.internal/files/postlaunch-may-delta.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya Tran: appreciate the quick triage team. long-term we should standardize an "attribution parity" test in the weekly report so this doesn't surprise us
Leah Park: Agreed. also let's add a short checklist for webinar registration redirect checks before next launch
Maya Tran: final ask for the meeting: let's land the metadata toggle and a 1-paragraph note for execs summarizing root cause + impact (estimate of % conversion moved). meet in 45
Evan Cole: sounds good. :thumbsup:
